title: CommonResponse
description: The fields of a response (COM-040, COM-050). Most responses have them; read, update when it reads, and validate don't (02-common.md §2, C-7). A refusal is exactly this object, with ok false and severity error.

ok.description: true: the command did what was asked. false: it refused.

severity.description: error for a refusal; info or warn for a success (warn where the command's chapter says so, COM-050).

node-path.description: A node path as segments without the root (overview 3.5): /soc/spi@7e204000 is ["soc", "spi@7e204000"], / is [].

suggestion.description: A value ready to pass to update, as list value gives it.

value.description: The value tokens as update takes them (GRM-070).

display_string.description: What to show instead of the value.

note.description: A remark on the value: the overlay mark of a phandle option (disabled, enabled, enabled by the overlay), or why the binding may reject the value ('not defined by <binding>; validate may reject it', or a value check's message such as 'Property spi-cpol is a flag and can be set to appear with 'true' or disappear with 'false''). Several are joined with '; '.

partial.description: The start of a name to type on (a pattern's stem).
